title: [IMP-8] KeyPackage endpoint and Welcome delivery have no API
description: Review finding IMP-8: KeyPackage endpoint and Welcome delivery have no API (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:50-51, :63-73; spec/07-compliance.md:185-195; spec/13-encoding.md:117 (not :181); spec/02-identity.md:302, :381; spec/04-access-control.md:147. Fix: As proposed. The type mismatch is confirmed: 07:190 uses `"type": "AgoraKeyPackageEndpoint"`, while 02:19/302, 05:63 and 10:466 use `KeyPackageEndpoint`. Q3 (KeyPackages at the identity host, found via the DID-doc KeyPackageEndpoint) settles where the endpoint is, not its API. The per-device fetch is a real gap: 05:65 says "a fetch atomically consume[s] the returned KeyPackage", one per fetch, while each device is a leaf (02:78). Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.1.1 "Endpoint Protocol": GET {kp} (one KeyPackage per device, CBOR array), GET {kp}?leaf=, POST {kp} (signed KeyPackagePublish), POST {kp}/welcome (message/mls, 202), status codes; service type unified as AgoraKeyPackageEndpoint (02 §2.1, 05, 07:225, 99 App. D)
